title: Lights out
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, abandoned summer camp in deep winter, snow-buried log cabins, a frozen lake ringed by black pines, cold moonlight against warm firelight, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 4. Every cabin light came on at once. 💡

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: twelve counselors from 1981 sang around a campfire on the frozen lake, and greeted Sam like they'd been waiting.
scenes.image: a campfire on a frozen lake at night, twelve blanketed figures around it

scenes.narration: Sam didn't go to them. He ran. Up the hill, through the drifts, into his cabin. He locked the door and stood with his back against it.
scenes.image: a man pressed against the inside of a cabin door, breathing hard, frost on the window

scenes.narration: Nothing followed. No footsteps. No singing. Just the wind, and his own heart.
scenes.image: an empty moonlit path through deep snow between dark cabins

scenes.narration: In the footlocker with the photos, he'd found a logbook. The 1981 caretaker's. He read it by flashlight.
scenes.image: a man reading an old cloth-bound logbook by flashlight in a dark cabin

scenes.narration: Firewood. Broken pipes. Deer in the mess hall. Then, the last week of August, the same line, over and over. Lights out at ten.
scenes.image: old logbook pages under a flashlight beam, faded handwriting blurred and unreadable

scenes.narration: The final entry was shaky. They didn't make it to lights out. It's my fault. Someday I'll come back and do it right.
scenes.image: a trembling flashlight beam on a closed logbook resting on a rough wooden table

scenes.narration: Sam checked his watch. One minute to ten.
scenes.image: a man glancing at his wristwatch in a flashlight beam, his breath visible in the cold

scenes.narration: At ten exactly, every cabin at Pine Hollow lit up at once. Twelve windows, glowing yellow in the snow. The power had been cut since September.
scenes.image: a row of snow-covered log cabins at night, every window suddenly glowing warm yellow

scenes.narration: Then, one by one, the lights went out. Slowly. Like someone walking down the row, tucking everyone in.
scenes.image: a row of log cabins at night, the windows going dark one after another

scenes.narration: Until only one window was still lit. His. And something knocked, very gently, on his door.
scenes.image: a single glowing cabin window in a dark snowy camp, footprints leading up to its door
